complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Create Enhanced Error Type System and Interfaces
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the creation of enhanced error type system into: 1) Define extended ErrorType enum with all error categories, 2) Create core interfaces (ExtractionResult, ExtractionAttempt, CacheEntry), 3) Create supporting interfaces (LogEntry, ExtractionConfig) with error context properties
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate complexity due to TypeScript interface design and enum extension. Well-defined requirements make it straightforward but requires careful type design for future extensibility.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide logging system implementation into: 1) Create Logger class with log level management, 2) Implement contextual logging with URL and timing data, 3) Add storage strategies (console/localStorage), 4) Create log formatting and client-side error boundary integration
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Higher complexity due to multiple storage strategies, contextual data handling, and integration requirements. Needs careful design for performance and debugging capabilities.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Build Retry Handler with Exponential Backoff
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break retry handler into: 1) Implement exponential backoff algorithm with configurable delays, 2) Create error-specific retry strategies, 3) Add progress tracking and cancellation support, 4) Implement timeout escalation and retry attempt logging
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Complex due to timing logic, cancellation handling, and different retry strategies per error type. Requires careful testing of async behavior and timing accuracy.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide caching system into: 1) Implement URL hash-based cache with Map storage, 2) Add TTL management and cleanup intervals, 3) Create cache statistics and manual invalidation, 4) Implement LRU eviction and cache warming capabilities
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate-high complexity due to TTL management, cleanup intervals, and LRU eviction logic. Memory management and performance considerations add complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break fallback strategies into: 1) Create selector hierarchy implementation (#content.content, #content, article, main), 2) Implement largest text block heuristic and content quality scoring, 3) Add strategy success logging and automatic selection logic
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate complexity due to multiple parsing strategies and heuristic algorithms. Content quality scoring adds some complexity but strategies are well-defined.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Enhance Error Handler with Detailed Context
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide error handling into: 1) Create ErrorHandler class with error categorization, 2) Implement detailed context tracking (timestamps, attempts, partial success), 3) Add user-friendly suggestions and recovery recommendations, 4) Create debug mode stack trace handling and analytics integration
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate-high complexity due to error categorization logic, context tracking, and suggestion generation. Integration with analytics and debug modes adds complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break configuration system into: 1) Create ConfigManager class with settings validation and defaults, 2) Implement localStorage persistence and retrieval, 3) Add configuration migration system for version updates
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate complexity due to localStorage operations, validation logic, and migration handling. Well-defined settings make implementation straightforward.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide analytics system into: 1) Create Analytics class with metric collection (success rates, times, errors), 2) Implement local storage and anonymization, 3) Add metric aggregation and reporting functions, 4) Create performance benchmarking and optional external integration
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate-high complexity due to metric aggregation, anonymization requirements, and performance monitoring. Multiple data sources and storage considerations add complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Enhance Markdown Converter with Error Recovery
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break markdown enhancement into: 1) Implement try-catch wrapper with multiple fallback strategies, 2) Add conversion quality indicators and HTML/Markdown comparison, 3) Create custom rule error handling and selective rule disabling
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate complexity due to multiple fallback strategies and quality assessment. Building on existing converter reduces complexity but error recovery adds sophistication.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break status component into: 1) Create ExtractionStatus component with real-time progress display, 2) Implement progress indicators and estimated time remaining, 3) Add cancellation options and accessibility features with animations
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate complexity due to real-time updates and accessibility requirements. React component with progress tracking is straightforward but UX considerations add some complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide debug panel into: 1) Create DebugPanel component with keyboard shortcut activation, 2) Implement error stack traces and extraction history display, 3) Add cache statistics and performance metrics visualization, 4) Create manual cache clearing and selector testing tools, 5) Implement export functionality (JSON/CSV) and responsive design
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to multiple data sources, keyboard shortcuts, data visualization, and export functionality. Integration with all debug systems and responsive design adds significant complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Integrate Enhanced Error Handling into Extract Content Action
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break integration into: 1) Modify extract-content.ts to integrate RetryHandler and CacheManager, 2) Add ErrorHandler and Logger integration with extraction flow, 3) Implement timeout handling and progress callbacks, 4) Add cancellation support and performance tracking, 5) Ensure backward compatibility and API consistency
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to integration of multiple systems, maintaining backward compatibility, and coordinating async operations. Critical integration point requiring careful orchestration.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Update Main Page Component with Enhanced Features

complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate-high complexity due to multiple component integration, UI/UX considerations, and accessibility requirements. Coordination of various features adds complexity.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break adaptive timeout into: 1) Implement initial timeout with escalation strategy (10s, 15s, 20s, 30s), 2) Create historical response time tracking and dynamic adjustment, 3) Add timeout feedback and progress indicators for users, 4) Implement domain-specific optimization and timeout analytics
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to adaptive algorithms, historical data tracking, and dynamic adjustment logic. Performance correlation and analytics integration add sophistication.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break test suite into: 1) Create unit tests for retry logic and error handling, 2) Implement caching and fallback strategy tests, 3) Add integration tests for extraction flow and mock server scenarios, 4) Create end-to-end tests with real URLs, 5) Implement test coverage reporting and performance benchmarks, 6) Set up automated test execution and CI/CD integration

complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to performance optimization requirements, comprehensive documentation needs, and validation against specific targets. Multiple deliverable types add scope.
